opportunity.title: WaterAid Ethiopia consultancy: THRIVE WASH baseline survey / GEDSI analysis
opportunity.source: WaterAid Ethiopia tender call (secondary discovery; original tender documents require registration on issuer bids page)
opportunity.opportunity_summary: WaterAid Ethiopia is seeking consultancy firms for Lot I, a baseline survey for the THRIVE WASH Project, and Lot II, a Gender, Disability and Social Inclusion analysis in Bahir Dar Zuriya. Tender documents are available 17-29 September 2026 after registering an email address through WaterAid Ethiopia's bids page; submission deadline reported as 30 September 2026 at 13:30 EAT.
opportunity.fit_summary: Potentially strong fit for Tuku-Tuku's research/MEL, programme diagnostics, facilitation and evidence-to-action capabilities, but Ethiopia registration/eligibility, TOR-specific technical credentials and local delivery requirements are not yet verified.
opportunity.decision_rationale: Advance to TOR retrieval and eligibility gate; do not commit to Bid until original TOR confirms foreign-firm eligibility and required specialist/firm experience.
mandatory_requirements: Full TOR requirements pending issuer-document retrieval
deliverables: Lot I baseline survey OR Lot II GEDSI analysis; exact deliverables pending TOR
opportunity.winning_strategy: Retrieve the issuer TOR immediately, select only the lot where Tuku-Tuku can evidence the strongest technical team and institutional track record, and use locally grounded Ethiopian expertise if required.
opportunity.source_context: Fresh discovery on 18 Sep 2026. Secondary tender listings report tender documents available through WaterAid Ethiopia after email registration from 17-29 Sep and submission by 30 Sep 13:30 EAT. Original issuer documents still need extraction before Verified status.
opportunity.next_action: Register/retrieve the original WaterAid Ethiopia tender documents, extract both TORs, run foreign-firm and specialist eligibility gate, then decide Lot I vs Lot II and enrich canonical JakeOS record.
